messages.author: dc8b4131b39a099f
messages.subject: Model-validation methods
parts:
Dear unmarked users and developers-

I'm working a database with count data for forest bird species, sampled from four watersheds in each of four consecutive years, and am using the pcount function for the N-mixture model to estimate spp. relative abundance.   I also have data from a fifth watershed in one year for use in validating the best model of spp. abundance from the other four watersheds.

I've done some reading on model-validation methods (e.g., k-fold cross-validation for resource selection functions), but haven't found anything that appears applicable to closed population, repeat-visit-based models like the N-mixture model.  Does anyone have any recommendations for validation methods that will help us use our validation database?

Best regards,

Matt

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Model-validation methods

hi Matt,
If I understand your question properly, then I don't see any reason
why a cross-validation type of exercise wouldn't work and so I would
recommend doing that. I guess the problem is figuring out what "fit
statistic" to use in this context. I don't have any great ideas there
but something like a RMSE will probably get you started.
regards
andy
